context.purpose: Prepare exact PNG details and indexed contact sheets from bounded captured raster images.
context.assumptions: Declared or explicitly assumed sRGB encoded samples; no colour transformation. Top-left integer pixel coordinates.
context.constraints: 1–8 RGB/RGBA8 non-interlaced PNGs; 8MiB each; 1048576 aggregate input pixels and aggregate publication pixels including sheet, 4096 per side. No ICC, APNG, compressed text, palettes, 16-bit, arbitrary options or delegates.
context.inspection: Inspect image-NN.png, optional sheet.png and raster-summary.json. Summary contains IDs, dimensions, colour assumptions, pixel hashes and sheet index/positions; no visual labels.
context.recovery: INVALID_RASTER_SOURCE: absolute regular local PNG. INVALID_RASTER_PNG: unsupported chunk/format or corrupt/budgeted data. RASTER_COLOUR_REQUIRED: tag as sRGB or explicitly assume-srgb. RASTER_CROP_OUTSIDE: fit crop within source. RASTER_PIXEL_BUDGET: reduce crop, scale or sheet. INVALID_RASTER_ALPHA: omit unused background. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure ImageMagick 7.

workflow.scope: Verified PNG artifacts feed downstream PNG preparation; normal scheduler handoffs retain provenance.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure expressions and finite studies resolve before the native recipe.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers version, policy listing, all prepare/composite children and verification. Each child CPU 60s, address space 1GiB, file output 16MiB; native PNG cache 128MiB and no map/disk spill.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned process-group cancellation; serial child execution and final cancellation check before publication.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/effective plan, complete source captures and byte bindings, scoped security policy, exact launcher/commands/input hashes, stage stdout/stderr/submissions, native images and independently computed summary.
lifecycle.verification: Independent dependency-free stdlib PNG CRC/chunk/filter/decompression decoder reconstructs every expected RGBA sample and layout. Native command, input, policy, membership and runtime records are also checked.

losses: Only the documented bounded PNG subset is accepted; physical resolution and metadata are stripped.
data.scope: Captured regular local PNG, aggregate input pixel budget applies.

losses: Crop discards outside samples; integer scaling replicates; flatten discards alpha and blends encoded samples, not linear light; sheet has metadata index without visual labels.
data.scope: PNG publications ordered by images, optional sheet, then text summary.

inspection.scope: Exact pixel image publications and optional contact sheet.
inspection.limits: RGBA8 PNG only, combined publication pixel budget 1048576; no typography/colour appearance claim.

inspection.scope: JSON dimensions, observed colour assumptions, IDs, sample hashes and sheet index.
inspection.limits: Host-authored inspection summary, not a native identify readback.

authoring.reuse: Change the absolute PNG source and crop/scale/quarterTurns. Retain source bytes for provenance; same-path byte changes invalidate scheduler reuse.

native-inspection.scope: No interactive native inspection; verified PNGs and index metadata are ordinary publications.

mpi.scope: The recipe is serial and each child is limited to one thread.

time-batches.scope: No native temporal batching; common finite studies remain available.

live-editing.scope: No persistent native session; edit JSON then create a new bounded run.

native-save.scope: PNG publications are supported; no application session/project save.

conversion.scope: No colour-space or file-format conversion; only declared PNG sample preparation.

reusable-inputs.scope: The absolute source path and its captured byte digest participate in reuse identity.

source-authoring.scope: Editable JSON source with common undo and validation.

property-authoring.scope: Common pointer forms expose all crop, scale, quarter-turn, alpha, colour-policy and sheet controls.

cases.scope: Literal 3x2 RGBA grid establishes every sample, including RGB beneath zero alpha; independent stdlib PNG decode reconstructs crop, replication, clockwise rotation, encoded-sample flatten and exact sheet placements. Host summary is not native readback.
